name: Supaste
soft_passes: #2 grid: horizontally centred with clean margins but vertically top-weighted — large dead blue field fills the lower two-thirds; defensible only under the clipboard-clip reading
#3 silhouette: reads as one clean anchor (a horizontal bar) but the shape is generic — names 'a row', not 'clipboard history'
#10 variants: strong figure-ground survives a tint/mono recolour, but it's a single baked raster with a hardcoded gradient, not authored as layers for default/dark/clear/tinted
failures: #11 personality: template-default glyph-on-gradient — saturated vertical-blue squircle + one lone white pill; distinctive of nothing and communicates neither clipboard, paste, nor history
light_model: Single top-down source: field light-top/dark-bottom (sky logic), pill specular white-top -> blue-tint-bottom, subtle bright rim on the squircle's top edge, soft short micro-shadow under the pill. No mixed lighting. Gloss is hand-baked, not system-applied.
layer_stack: white glossy capsule (baked gloss + soft micro-shadow)
devices: single glossy capsule as the sole glyph (reductive to one element)
sky-logic electric-blue ramp with an empty lower-two-thirds field
baked specular gloss on the pill (old iOS/Big-Sur gesture, not Liquid Glass)
top-anchored bar readable as a clipboard-clip / top-of-list
rhymes_hint: iOS/Big-Sur 'single white glyph on a vertical-blue ramp' utility family (Messages-blue lineage; generic clipboard/notes utilities); style family: saturated-gradient minimalist utility
notes: 256x256 lossy WebP web render (not the 1024 master) - fine specular/translucency/noise not observable; at 256 clearly an opaque gloss with no refraction/true translucency, so read as a Big-Sur baked gradient icon, NOT Icon Composer Liquid Glass despite shipping in the macOS 26 era. Micro-shadow under the pill is subtle and partly compression. Gradient endpoints and pill gloss ramp are (measured) from this render. Icon<->brand palette coherence is strong: the cover's hero sky gradient (#73C9FF->#2460DB) is the same ramp and the cover shows a #0080FF brand-blue swatch. Icon<->subject communication is weak: nothing signals clipboard/paste/history. Only #11 is a hard fail; the three soft passes plus that fail paint the honest picture - mechanically immaculate (mask/light/palette/contrast/16px all solid), characterically anonymous.
